messages:
Elaine Park: hey team — quick heads up, i opened a PR to update the console heatmap example and the tracing-hook cost breakdown to the v2 schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421

Samir Rao: looked at the PR, thanks. main concern: the node snippet uses the old traceKey param. we need to show both node+python minimal examples and call out the fallback behavior when kv-prefixing is enabled.

Jordan Chen: tagging the previews — @docs-bot can you render the playground preview for the new yaml sample? want to confirm the embed shows metric legends correctly.

docs-bot: @Jordan Chen preview build queued for pr/5421 — will post url when ready :hammer_and_wrench: 

Miguel Torres: i can own the link sweep for this PR. i noticed three internal links that redirect (console links). will also add a short note in the migration guide about tracekey renames.

Ken Liu: Heads up: in Dedicated we still accept the legacy cost fields for a while — add a compatibility note and example of how to opt-in to new schema. small snippet: ```js
// node example: v2 trace context
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/codex-v2',
  prompt: '...',
  trace_context: { trace_key: 'sdk:tracekey:v2' }
})
```

Samir Rao: nice. can we also add a test prompt under examples/soak that triggers the heatmap so QA can validate cost buckets?

Elaine Park: yes — Jordan can you drop a tiny jsonl with a few prompts in the PR (one short, one long, one with long kv prefix)? that will help the preview render the buckets.

Jordan Chen: on it. putting a minimal jsonl in docs/examples/heatmap/soak.jsonl. also verified preview link: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/pull/5421 (render looks okay, legend clipped on mobile).

Miguel Torres: link sweep done, fixed two redirects and updated one internal anchor. left a comment in the PR explaining the change.

docs-bot: ci/test-suite for pr/5421 completed — 128 tests passed, 2 flaky skipped.

Ken Liu: small suggestion: add an inline note under "Cost breakdown" that clarifies when kv-cache attribution shows 0 tokens (edge case for short prefixes). I can draft a line.

Samir Rao: SGTM. also please add a tiny snippet showing how to map trace ids to dashboards using the new trace hex export.

Elaine Park: thanks all — plan: merge after Jordan uploads the jsonl + Ken's line and after a quick smoke from QA. target EOD. :shipit: 

Jordan Chen: uploaded jsonl, pushed a tiny copy change to the heatmap caption about mobile clipping.
